bundle.longDescription: Benchtop gathers 242 developer and engineering utilities (formatters, converters, query and validation tools, encoders, hashes, keys and JWTs, text comparison, network and DevOps helpers, generators, CSS, colour and image tools, a Bootstrap theme builder, and projection, electrical, mechanical and HVAC calculators) in one desktop app. Everything works offline except the online checks (website status, SSL, DNS, WHOIS and ports), which contact only the hosts you enter when you press Check and can be turned off in Settings.
